issue_context.title: `UP035` doesn't detect `typing_extensions.override` when targeting python 3.12
issue_context.body:
```py
from typing_extensions import override  # no error
```
https://play.ruff.rs/f12262a2-a134-4035-8901-6e1affb88555

`override` was added to the `typing` module in 3.12, so ruff should complain here

review_comments: I just grepped for "New in version 3.12" in the typing documentation.
`collections.abc.Buffer` and `types.get_original_bases` are also both new in py312 (and backported via `typing_extensions`) — you could add those as well!
